condition: On main (after PR #25022), line_search with a large c1 (e.g. 0.4) raises ValueError from math.sqrt in _cubicmin when the cubic interpolation has a negative radical. In 1.18.1 the cubic step was skipped and a quadratic step was used instead.
workaround: Use a smaller c1 (for example the default 1e-4), or stay on SciPy 1.18.1 until _cubicmin is changed to return None when radical < 0.
